en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph showing a large stone crucifixion monument, surrounded by three additional religious statues and approached by steps. There are two people, likely children, kneeling at the steps. The background has some buildings and trees, typical of a French rural or small town setting. Below the photograph, there is printed text in French identifying the scene as 'Le Portel - Le Calvaire.' Additionally, handwriting in French is visible at the bottom. The back side contains handwriting, French-language printed text, postmarks, and a French 10-cent stamp from the early 1900s, as well as mailing details to Sweden. A stamp from the Vänersborgs Museum is also visible.
